name: Gayan Madurapperuma
designation: Founder & Chief Executive Officer, SLEDMC – Sri Lankan European Skills Development & Mobility Center
message:
SLEDMC was born from a simple belief: talent should not be limited by geography.

Having lived and worked in Europe and experienced the realities of both the European labour market and the aspirations of people from Sri Lanka, I saw an opportunity to build a bridge between the two.

Across Europe, employers are looking for motivated, skilled and reliable people. At the same time, many talented Sri Lankans are looking for genuine opportunities to develop their skills and build a better future through international employment.

I believe the answer is not simply to connect a worker with a job. We need to prepare people for the journey.

That means developing professional skills, language ability, workplace knowledge, cultural understanding, and the confidence to succeed in a new environment.

This is why we are building SLEDMC not simply as a recruitment organisation, but as a skills development and European workforce mobility platform.

Through SLEDMC Academy, our European partners and our growing network of employers, we want to create a structured pathway:

Develop Skills → Prepare People → Connect Opportunities → Support Mobility → Build Careers

Our ambition is to create opportunities that are professional, transparent, and sustainable — while helping European businesses access talent that is properly prepared for the workplace.

SLEDMC is my commitment to building a stronger connection between Sri Lankan talent and European opportunity.
philosophy: People are not resources — they are the engine of every organisation. We invest in understanding both sides of every equation to create matches that last.
